data.name: Revati
data.gender_notes: Revati is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit revat, 'wealthy' — Revatī, a nakshatra. Its root is Sanskrit revat (रेवत्). A nakshatra in Vedic astrology; wife of Balarama. Revati is a Sanskrit name meaning “A star (Revati); wealthy”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Revati expresses “A star (Revati); wealthy”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit revat, 'wealthy' — Revatī, a nakshatra.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Revati total 30, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
